title: Multiply by shifting and adding
task: The words at a (0x800) and b (0x804) are unsigned, each 0 to 65535. Store a × b at product (0x808), then end with B . . There is no multiply instruction: for each bit of b, from the lowest, add a shifted left by the bit's position when the bit is 1. LSRS R1, R1, #1 shifts the lowest bit of b into C and sets Z when no 1 bits are left; ADDCS adds only when that bit was 1. To run it in a processor view, choose "Extended datapath" in the instruction-set menu: immediates there are 0 to 255. Keep the .equ lines: the tests write the data at those addresses.
starter:
; shift-multiply -- practice exercise (MAVILERA, ARMv7)
; Store a × b by shift and add.
; Hint: LSRS, ADDCS, LSL, and BNE while bits are left.
        .equ  a, 0x800          ; the tests write and read here
        .equ  b, 0x804          ; the tests write and read here
        .equ  product, 0x808    ; the tests write and read here

done:   B     done           ; replace with your code; B . ends the run
